Subsequent APIs such as `spare_capacity_mut()` then trust this corrupted `cap` value and may create out-of-bounds slices, leading to UB.

This behavior is observable in release builds (integer overflow wraps), whereas de

expect.note: bytes 1.7.1 is used everywhere (actix-http, hyper, h2, etc.), but the bug needs BytesMut::reserve(additional) with new_cap+offset overflowing usize, so additional must be near usize::MAX. Server-side reserve callers pass bounded sizes: actix-http h1/mod.rs:61 and dispatcher.rs:989 (HW buffer), encoder.rs:269,301 (header-based), helpers.rs (50).
